instruction: Remove all applications from favorites except Google Chrome

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires keeping only Chrome in favorites and removing all others. Initial apps are ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. Evaluator verifies list contains only Chrome using check_gnome_favorite_apps.

Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies the single requirement - that favorites list contains only google-chrome.desktop
Expected value is semantically correct: ['google-chrome.desktop'] matches the instruction requirement to keep only Chrome
Correct parameter handling: Metric directly accesses rule['expected'] (line 6) as required for type='rule'

No error handling: Function does not handle malformed output or parsing failures
